canonical_project: TTC adjacent micro data center (landing-station production environment)
owner: Tuvalu Telecommunications Corporation (TTC); IIJ reportedly engaged in earlier government micro-DC discussions (vendor history only)
notes: Per JICA 2026 survey (A-grade primary), a micro data center is planned adjacent to the TTC Funafuti facility for the Vaka landing-station production environment; equipment was in transit as of 2025-09 and arrival/commissioning is unconfirmed. Asset class: micro-dc (government/TTC micro facility), status: in transit/planned - do not treat as an operational DC until a newer source confirms delivery/commissioning. This is the closest thing to a datacenter project in Tuvalu; capacity unknown.
